name: ITC Hotels Ltd.
about: ITC Hotels Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels and resorts in India and internationally. The company operates under the ITC Hotels, Mementos, Storii, EPIQ Collection, Welcomhotel, Fortune Hotels, and WelcomHeritage brands. It also owns and operates golf club under the Classic Golf & Country Club name. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Gurugram, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~34% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~18% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.7% cost of equity).
PE of 41 is near the bottom of its range over the past year (median 58), though that is a short history to judge by.
